Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the final analysis by incorrectly concluding which album was released earlier. The data collected by the WebSurfer clearly indicated that "Was I the Wave?" was released on April 26, 2011, and "Kingdom of Rock" on November 6, 2015. The Planner mistakenly stated that "Kingdom of Rock" was released earlier than "Was I the Wave?" despite the correct information being provided. This misinterpretation of the collected data led to the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
